title: Execution Context & Scope Boundaries
summary: Select and configure agent tools, set up MCP servers with registries and allow lists, integrate agents into CI, and implement safe execution with robust error handling.

rows: Agent can only act within triggering repo
GitHub token scoped to single repo
Agent can only write to specific branch
Agent only runs on CI events
Agent can only deploy to specific environments

blocks.text: **Key Fact from GitHub Docs:** Copilot cloud agent pushes to a `copilot/` prefixed branch when not working on an existing PR. It can ONLY push to that branch — never directly to main or other protected branches.
